# <!--name-->edot-release/version<!--/name-->

[![usages](https://img.shields.io/badge/usages-white?logo=githubactions&logoColor=blue)](https://github.com/search?q=elastic%2Foblt-actions%2Fedot-release%2Fversion+%28path%3A.github%2Fworkflows+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yml+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yaml%29&type=code)
[![test-edot-release-version](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-edot-release-version.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-edot-release-version.yml)

<!--description-->
Derive EDOT release tags and versions from repository state.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs

<!--inputs-->
| Name                  | Description                                                                                     | Required | Default |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------|
| `command`             | Version operation: highest-tag, previous-tag, next-patch, release-version, or next-development. | `true`   | ` `     |
| `tag-prefix`          | Prefix on release tags, such as v. Leave empty for plain X.Y.Z tags.                            | `false`  | ` `     |
| `line`                | Optional X.Y release line for highest-tag.                                                      | `false`  | ` `     |
| `ref-name`            | Branch name for previous-tag.                                                                   | `false`  | ` `     |
| `version`             | Version or tag for next-patch and next-development.                                             | `false`  | ` `     |
| `previous-tag`        | Previous release tag for release-version.                                                       | `false`  | ` `     |
| `development-version` | Current development version for release-version.                                                | `false`  | ` `     |
| `bump`                | Release bump for release-version: minor or major.                                               | `false`  | ` `     |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs

<!--outputs-->
| Name    | Description                 |
|---------|-----------------------------|
| `value` | The derived tag or version. |
<!--/outputs-->

## Usage

The repository must be checked out with full history and tags.

<!--usage action="elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/version" version="env:VERSION"-->
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    with:
      fetch-depth: 0
  - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/version@v1
    id: version
    with:
      command: highest-tag
      tag-prefix: v
```
<!--/usage-->
